text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in sharp decline, down 4.6% and 6.1% respectively over 24 hours, with altcoins falling harder, signaling broad-based selling pressure rather than isolated weakness. The Fear & Greed Index at 10 reflects extreme fear that has deepened over the past week, while Bitcoin dominance holding at 58.6% suggests investors are rotating into the safest asset rather than abandoning crypto entirely. Volume at $117B remains substantial, indicating this is an active selloff rather than apathy, typical of a correction phase rather than capitulation.
